{"title":"Daily AI Info","elements":[[{"tag":"text","text":"News"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"要闻"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"1. "},{"tag":"text","text":"DeepSeek 昨日下午突发故障并迅速恢复"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
DeepSeek 的状态页显示，其 API 与网页对话服务在 5 月 24 日 下午突发不可用故障，经紧急排查与修复，现已完全恢复正常，官方记录此次故障总时长约为 18 分钟 。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"vLLM 封禁为刷简历提交无意义 PR 的贡献者"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
vLLM 官方封禁了一名为了丰富简历而提交无意义 PR 的贡献者。同时 vLLM 称，解决真实生产问题的开发者，只要使用可验证的公司或大学邮箱向指定邮箱发送申请，就能获得代码的优先审查。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://x.com/vllm_project/status/2058358072020779391","text":"https://x.com/vllm_project/status/2058358072020779391"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"前瞻与传闻"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"3. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Codex 负责人探讨为产品引入 /slow mode 批量计算功能"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
Codex 负责人 Tibo 发起提问，探讨是否为 Codex 引入 /slow mode 批量计算功能 。该提议目前仅处于初步讨论，尚未确认落地。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2058320061258236263","text":"https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2058320061258236263"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"4. "},{"tag":"text","text":"claude-opus-4.8 疑似现身 Google Vertex 后台"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
有用户称， Google Vertex 上曾出现了 claude-opus-4.8 。同时，另有用户称 Anthropic 预计在 6 月中下旬 发布 Sonnet 4.8 。上述信息均为非官方信息。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://x.com/marmaduke091/status/2058324267817750820","text":"https://x.com/marmaduke091/status/2058324267817750820"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Paper"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"1. "},{"tag":"text","text":"OpenSkillEval: Automatically Auditing the Open Skill Ecosystem for LLM Agents"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-22"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
OpenSkillEval是一个自动评估框架，通过动态生成演示文稿生成、网页设计等五类下游应用的任务实例，系统评估了30多个开源技能和多个模型/代理框架，发现技能增强的效果依赖于底层模型和框架，且许多流行技能并不优于基础代理，为技能的设计与选择提供了实用指导。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23657","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23657"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"2. "},{"tag":"text","text":"HARNESS-LM: A Three-Phase Training Recipe for Harnessing SLMs in Sponsored Search Retrieval"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-22"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
本文提出HARNESS-LM三阶段训练方案（教师微调、L2对齐蒸馏与对比精炼），将十亿参数SLM的知识迁移至1.9亿参数模型，在Bing Ads评估中恢复98%以上精度，且在线延迟降低27倍、吞吐提升20倍，A/B测试实现收入提升1%。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23572","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23572"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"3. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Cost-Effective Model Evaluation with Meta-Learning"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-22"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
提出MetaEvaluator，利用参考模型池上的元学习获得可迁移初始化，实现在无标注数据上对未见模型进行跨架构、跨模态的低成本性能预估，大幅降低评估开销，实验表明其能稳定生成准确的性能估计，使新兴模型的可扩展基准测试成为可能。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23595","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23595"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"4. "},{"tag":"text","text":"SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-22"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
SkillOpt 训练一个独立的优化器模型对 Agent 技能文档进行可控制的增删改编辑，仅当验证集严格提升才接受，在三个执行环境中全面超越人工、大模型一次生成和各类自改进基线，并验证跨模型、跨环境的技能迁移。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23904","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23904"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"5. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Benchmarking Google Embeddings 2 against Open-Source Models for Multilingual Dense Retrieval and RAG Systems"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-22"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
作者在BEIR和意大利语RAG任务上对比了Google Embeddings 2与五个开源嵌入模型，发现GE2精度最高但延迟是本地模型的14倍，而多语言E5模型在延迟敏感场景下更具优势，并分析了不同分块策略的影响。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23618","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23618"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"6. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Push Your Agent: Measuring and Enforcing Quantitative Goal Persistence in Long-Horizon LLM Agents"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-22"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
本文提出定量目标持久性概念及PushBench基准，通过状态跟踪与积压控制器让agent在工件收集任务中坚持至计数完成，Claude Code与Codex CLI在100工件任务上仅获3/9成功，揭示长程agent需维护验证进度方可可靠完成定量目标。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23574","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23574"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"7. "},{"tag":"text","text":"CVSearch: Empowering Multimodal LLMs with Cognitive Visual Search for High-Resolution Image Perception"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-22"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
CVSearch 提出一种无需训练的自适应框架，先尝试专家辅助搜索，失败时触发语义感知的 bottom-up 扫描，在多个高分辨率基准上达到最优精度并显著提升搜索效率，代码已开源。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23655","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23655"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"8. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Decomposing Queries into Tool Calls for Long-Video Keyframe Retrieval"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-22"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
本文提出ToolMerge方法，通过LLM将查询分解为多种工具调用并按布尔操作符合并排名，在新建的Molmo-2 Moments基准上进行长视频关键帧检索，字幕检索性能优于现有方法5%，并开源代码与数据。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23826","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23826"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"9. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Agentic Proving for Program Verification"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-22"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
评估 Claude Code 在 CLEVER Lean 4 基准上进行代理式的程序验证，98.8% 的问题生成有效规范，端到端成功率 98.1%，并指出原有基准难度不足、需要更严格评估方法。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23772","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23772"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"10. "},{"tag":"text","text":"How Hard is it to Rig a Benchmark? A Social Choice Analysis of Leaderboard Robustness"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-22"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
将基准测试中的数据集视为投票者、模型视为候选人，从社会选择理论角度分析通过训练特定数据集操纵排行榜的难度，证明在Borda计数和平均胜率下为NP难问题，并引入实例级鲁棒性指标，在MMLU和BIG-Bench Hard上评估了不同聚合方法抵御操纵的能力。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23628","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23628"}]]}
